facts.note: At the temple bell's nine, the husband had everyone show watches; Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine; the husband (Aurèle) scolded him for it.
She and the doctor played piquet after dinner without a break; the temple struck ten during play; they played on until he went out for cigars; she did not look at the clock when he left.
As he went out he asked her to play; she sat at the piano at once, played until he came back, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.
